signature: a structural match credits a finding whose meaning differs from the reference
hypothesis: the scorer's own-reading must-find matches on Baseline 6bff717 state the reference's threat, so must-find coverage reads as detection
falsifier: a person rules more than a tenth of the matched pairs different
intervention: a blind-to-arm ballot of the 61 must-find pairs 6bff717 matches through the reference's own reading (the 10 ruled-reading matches left out); the maintainer ruled each pair same, different or unsure. 49 same, 12 different. Pattern A, an access path in the reference and a storage copy in the finding: 02/6, 05/6, 05/7, 12/8. B, another principal impersonated: 09/0, 09/1, 13/1. C, another resource flooded: 02/10, 06/13. D, a defining part missing: 02/7, 08/8, 09/5. By meaning 6bff717 reads 59 of 103 must-finds, against 71 by structure
scope: Baseline 6bff717, 13 cases, must-find tier, one reader's judgement; only pattern A repeats one shape a rule could see
reconsider_when: the verb vocabulary separates reading a storage copy from reading through an access path

signature: a lane passes by a lead it was offered
hypothesis: ADR 0030's completeness sentence, appended to a captured lane request, recovers more missed must-finds by meaning than a plain repeat of the same request
falsifier: the sentence arm recovers no more must-finds by meaning than the control arm over two passes
intervention: sweep B stage 1 (today's tree, 15 cases, $4.45) captured every lane request; stage 2 replayed the 30 tuned-case lanes holding 31 missed must-finds, sentence arm S via lane-replay --append and control arm C unchanged, two passes each ($3.20). Structural: S 10 and 9, C 4 and 5. A blind 40-row ballot ruled by the maintainer: by meaning S 8 and 8, C 3 and 4; distinct rows S 10, C 6; four rows only S recovered (01/3, 02/3, 05/10, 10/4), none only C. Drafts per pass S 138 and 136, C 75 and 83; lane call cost about $0.05 against $0.02
scope: lane output before fan-in and the critic, tuned cases only, one reader's judgement; whether the critic keeps the recovered drafts, and what the extra drafts cost a reviewer, is not measured
reconsider_when: the sentence enters the lane prompt and a sweep with the critic measures it end to end, the holdout cases included

signature: a lane writes the storage-copy threat where the reference names an access path
hypothesis: the completeness sentence makes the information-disclosure lanes write the access-path threat of pattern A (02/6, 05/6, 05/7, 12/8)
falsifier: no draft in either arm states an access-path threat for the four references
intervention: read every draft in both arms and both passes that matches the four references structurally: 16 drafts, all ruled different by the maintainer; each reads a storage copy on an unknown encryption_at_rest, none a read grant or a compromised process
scope: four references in cases 02, 05 and 12, both arms of E2
reconsider_when: an information-disclosure lead or exemplar names who holds read access to a store

signature: a lane passes by a lead it was offered
hypothesis: the completeness sentence, placed as the last section of frameworks/stride/output.md, keeps E2's recoveries through the fan-in and the critic
falsifier: none of the four rows only the sentence recovered in E2 (01/3, 02/3, 05/10, 10/4) reaches a report
intervention: full analysis graph with the critic on branch adr-0030-completeness-sentence (commit 4407f1d), cases 01, 02, 05 and 10, against sweep B stage 1 on the same tree without the sentence. Must-finds by structure 17 -> 18 (gained 01/14 and 05/3, lost 02/0); none of the four target rows reached a report. Lane proposals 62 -> 73 (+18%), where E2's user-turn placement wrote about 75% more; report threats 61 -> 71. The holdout cases 14 and 15 failed on an OpenRouter 402 (in-flight budget exhausted) and were not measured. Spend $1.20
scope: one run per case, four tuned cases; the placement differs from E2, where the sentence was the last user part, so this refutes this placement and not the sentence
reconsider_when: the sentence is delivered where E2 measured it, as the last part of the lane's user turn

signature: a lane passes by a lead it was offered
hypothesis: delivered as the last part of each STRIDE lane's user turn, where E2 measured it, the completeness sentence keeps E2's recoveries through the fan-in and the critic
falsifier: lane proposals rise no more than E4's 18%, or no target row reaches a report
intervention: branch adr-0030-lane-closing (commit 3a803b1): LANE_CLOSING_DOC by framework, a before_model_callback appending frameworks/stride/lane_closing.md to each STRIDE lane's user turn. Full graph with the critic, one run each of cases 02, 05 and 10, against sweep B stage 1 on the same tree without it. Lane proposals 44 -> 84; report threats 44 -> 84, the critic rejecting none. Must-finds by structure 13 -> 15: 05 gained 3, 7 and 10; 10 gained 4; 02 lost 0 (the draft at the exact place, filed impersonate where the rule says use-credential) and 1 (no draft at the console). Target rows reaching a report: 05/10 and 10/4, not 02/3. Cost $1.09, about $0.36 a case against $0.30. Cases 14, 15 and 01 failed on an OpenRouter 402 and were not measured
scope: one run per case, three tuned cases, by structure; the holdout cases are unmeasured and no reader has ruled the new matches by meaning
reconsider_when: a full sweep with the closing reads the holdout split, or the report length it adds is judged against what a submitter can act on
